sn18.10:1.10: evaṃ passaṃ rāhula, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
sn18.10:1.11: nibbindaṃ virajjati. virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn18.10:1.12: ‘khīṇā jāti. vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ. nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī’ti.
